column1: You should review carefully the factors described under “Risk Factors” beginning on page 28 of this prospectus.  The primary assets of the issuing entity will include a pool of fixed rate motor vehicle retail installment sales contracts secured by new or used cars, crossover utility vehicles,  light-duty trucks and sport utility vehicles. The assets of the issuing entity will also include related security interests in the financed vehicles, proceeds from claims on related insurance policies, amounts deposited in specified bank  accounts and all proceeds of the foregoing.  The notes are asset-backed securities issued by the issuing entity and will be paid only from the assets of the issuing entity. The notes represent the obligations of the issuing  entity only and do not represent the obligations of or interests in Toyota Motor Credit Corporation or any of its affiliates. Neither the notes nor the receivables owned by the issuing entity are insured or guaranteed by any governmental  agency.
